name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement VQE from scratch
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement VQE from scratch in Qiskit for the H2 molecular Hamiltonian (Pauli form, 2 qubits), with a hardware-efficient ansatz of depth 1 and a scipy optimizer. Verify against numpy eigenvalues. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
